clips.title: The story
paras: The Test of Lore is a trial set by Braug Dimspirit at the entrance to Talondeep Path, testing a Horde adventurer's mind rather than their physical endurance. To pass, the seeker must venture deep into the haunted barrow dens of Ashenvale, recover an ancient tome of dragon history, and study its contents before being quizzed.

After proving their physical endurance and unwavering faith across the salt flats and plateaus of Thousand Needles, candidates under Dorn Plainstalker's series of trials are sent north to Braug Dimspirit in the Stonetalon Mountains. Stationed near the mouth of Talondeep Path, Braug dismisses the earlier challenges as simple physical exercises. To truly serve the Horde with distinction, an adventurer requires a sharp and disciplined intellect, prepared to understand ancient histories rather than merely striking down beasts.

Braug directs petitioners to venture through Talondeep Path into the forested reaches of southern Ashenvale. There, hidden beneath the canopy south of Splintertree Post, lies the Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The subterranean sanctuary is a perilous ruin haunted by fallen night elf druids and the vicious creatures that slaughtered them. Rested upon a stony podium deep in the lower chambers lies the prize: 'Legacy of the Aspects', a rare manuscript detailing the ancient creation and corruption of the great Dragon Aspects.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body—your mind is another matter completely.
I shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.
What book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bring me the book after you've studied it. I will not ask you your question until after you have given me the book.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... Unless you've forgotten to study its contents.
When you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.
